incinerator.name: Incinerator
incinerator.desc: Hold E with a Rift paper to burn it fast

ward.name: Ward Pylon
ward.desc: Protects an area: no Rift selection, zombies slowed, Host veil stripped

gauge.name: Rift Gauge
gauge.desc: Reads the station's pressure. It looks back: using it taints you

switchboard.name: Switchboard
switchboard.desc: Locks (or unlocks) the two nearest doors; a Host can contest them

breaker.name: Power Breaker
breaker.desc: Ends a blackout and floods the station with light, but wakes everything nearby

beacon.name: Decoy Beacon
beacon.desc: Pulls zombies in for 15 s, then detonates. Clear the blast area

emitter.name: Static Emitter
emitter.desc: Strips the Host's veil and slows it; stops a summon
